explanation.heading: Why this was flagged
explanation.text: Ama Serwaa Owusu's First Aid certificate expired on 15 Mar 2026, 1 day ago. The role requires it. The check compared the expiry date with the day of the check and found the certificate lapsed the day after its printed end date.

explanation.heading: Why it matters
explanation.text: An active person whose role requires a certification has no valid one at asOf (expiry day itself is still valid). A certificate is valid through the end date printed on it. The expiry date itself counts as a valid day; the certificate lapses the day after.
